regions.today: A dry day with good spells of sunshine. Highs of 10 to 13 degrees in light winds.
regions.tonight: It will be dry and rather cold tonight with clear spells. Mist and fog patches will form and frost will develop in some inland areas. Cloud will increase in eastern areas towards dawn. Lowest temperatures of 0 to 4 degrees with light and variable winds.
regions.tomorrow: A chilly start to tomorrow, Monday, with some sunny spells and any frost and fog clearing. Cloud will extend from the east in the morning and outbreaks of rain and drizzle will develop. The rain and drizzle will mainly affect eastern areas, but will gradually clear during the afternoon with some sunny spells developing. Highs of 10 to 13 degrees with light or moderate northeast to easterly winds.
